999.context: And I need to say this carefully because some of y'all are already getting to argue with the version of me you've made up in your head. I'm not saying every religious person is evil. I'm not saying your grandma was a monster because she prayed over you. I'm not saying people don't find comfort, community, discipline, or even hope inside religious spaces. I know they do. I lived it, I preached it, hell, I built it. But what I am saying is this when a belief system gets organized into an institution, and that institution gets access to money, law, politics, family, education, sexuality, and fear, we're no longer just talking about personal faith.
